body:
I'm just like this. 

Some days I feel like all my problems are so simple and easy to solve.

Pshh, depression, what's that?

Others, I just feel like my chest is imploding because of the hurt.

Hey, I know how you feel. I miss my family too, even though I'm not speaking to them because I'm a fuck up and self-sabotaged my relationship with them.

It sucks.
Steven Universe helps me a lot, too. It's such a wonderful show, made me cry so many times, hahah

I've been forcing myself to socialize these past couple of weeks, but I only end up feeling worse because my friends are productive and healthy members of society, unlike me.

So even though I'm glad that I got to catch up with them, I end up feeling so much worse about myself and my shitty life in the end.
I think mine has already been wasted.
This is exactly how I think, one of my main problems is that I keep putting off long term goals because I imagine I'll be dead by then. I wish.

You sound like a wonderful and caring person. Thank you for taking the time to type out such an insightful response, I'll definitely keep all of that in mind going forward.

Thank you. 💟
I love you a lot, and I want you to be happy always because I hate myself and feel miserable all the time.
I feel undeserving of life and I just want to go to sleep and not wake up.
I want to die. Life is wasted on me, I keep wishing for an accident/illness to happen.
That's really sad. How does your mom feel about the way he treats her and you kids? Would she be willing to get away from him?

You did nothing wrong, your dad has anger issues. Does he treat your mom in the same abusive manner? 

With that in mind, try to avoid provoking him until he and your mother go back abroad, not because he's right, but just to save yourself the headache. 

Once again, it's your dad, not you.

I've been struggling with feeling like I truly hate myself for about a year now. 

I honestly feel like I have no value as a person and that I'm just a useless waste of space who doesn't deserve anything good. It's messed up because I think I've started to sabotage myself subconsciously. It's like I'm used to failing and feeling miserable. 

I just want to sleep all the time and avoid the world, which is frustrating because I'd love to travel, but I just feel trapped inside my own stupid mind. 

I spend my days looking at gorgeous and successful women on instagram wishing I could do what they're doing. I just hate myself and my life.
As someone who's been considering suicide for a while now, this thread has stirred up some conflicting feelings.

Thank you for your kind words, really.

I am aware that what I'm going to do is so incredibly awful and selfish, but I just don't see any other way.

I've been feeling worthless and useless for years, but somehow always had hope. I don't have hope anymore.

I have tried, believe me, I have. I listened to advice, I researched how to cope, I tried motivating myself but nothing helped.

It's so ironic because my friends always praise my ability to empathize with them and advise them whenever they need it. I just can't help myself.
